clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Accepts Vice President Gibran Resignation
aiSummaryBullets: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka officially resigned from his position, with President Prabowo Subianto accepting the departure.
Gibran described his decision to step down as a personal choice, while the President cited educational reasons for the resignation.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Leaders Consult On Appointment Of New Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto is holding meetings with coalition parties and legislative leadership to determine a successor for the vacant vice presidency.
The People's Consultative Assembly aims to finalize the appointment process for the new vice president by December 4.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Authorities Detail Probe Into Illegal Wiretapping Case
aiSummaryBullets: Law enforcement officials are investigating an illegal wiretapping operation reportedly targeting President Prabowo Subianto.
A Brigadier General identified only as TK is currently undergoing questioning by the police internal affairs division.

clusters.headline: Jensen Huang Resigns As NVIDIA CEO Following Personal Scandals
aiSummaryBullets: Jensen Huang has officially stepped down as the CEO and President of NVIDIA.
The resignation follows public reports regarding espionage allegations and an extramarital affair.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Customs Officials Sentenced In Bribery And Graft Case
aiSummaryBullets: Three former Directorate General of Customs and Excise officials received prison sentences between six and nine years.
The convictions stem from bribery and gratuities linked to the importation of imitation goods involving PT BlueRay Cargo.

clusters.headline: Indonesia Records State Budget Deficit Of Rp 379 Trillion By October
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesia's state budget deficit reached Rp 379.3 trillion as of October 2026.
Government expenditure on subsidies and compensation totaled Rp 415.8 trillion for the same period.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Ministry Recognizes Regional Economic Growth Achievements
aiSummaryBullets: Minister of Home Affairs Tito Karnavian received a special award for driving regional welfare, economic growth, and fiscal management.
The city of Pekanbaru was awarded first place for regional economic growth acceleration and received financial assistance of IDR 2 billion.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Officials Address Fuel Subsidy Costs And Market Prices
aiSummaryBullets: Government officials confirm that fuel subsidy allocations remain secure for the remainder of 2026 despite rising global oil prices.
Finance Ministry representatives stated that market prices for Pertalite and Solar fuels significantly exceed the current subsidized consumer rates.

clusters.headline: Indonesia Reports State Budget Performance Through October 2026
aiSummaryBullets: The Ministry of Finance reported a budget deficit of Rp379.3 trillion as of October 2026.
State spending reached Rp2,997.2 trillion by October 2026, representing 78 percent of the annual budget.

clusters.headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Formally Resigns As Indonesian Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: Gibran Rakabuming Raka has officially submitted a resignation letter to the People's Consultative Assembly of Indonesia.
Following the announcement, Gibran expressed apologies and gratitude toward President Prabowo Subianto.
